notes.title: Röki Patch Notes - 4th December
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019928/924c2cb9a1f5216f88901e66dc24a28d0d3d2542.png

Hi everyone!

It’s been a while… but don’t worry, we haven’t forgotten about you just yet! 
With this update, we’re bringing some few adjustments and improvements, listed below. 

Fixes & Improvements:
❄️ Act restart - You can now restart the Act in which you are playing at any time, by choosing the option in the pause menu
❄️ Fixed an issue that could occur during cutscenes in Act 2
❄️ Fixed an issue that could prevent progression during a scene transition in Act 3

We’re also very proud to have been nominated for The Game Awards, in the “Best Debut Game” category! You can support us by voting for Röki, it would mean the world to us!
Vote HERE.

Please don’t hesitate to keep sending us comments on the Steam forum, or messages at support@unitedlabelgames.com.

Thank you again for playing!

notes.title: Röki Patch Notes - 30th July
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36019928/37b99ecd89d93a4cc05f055424691aec080f2ba5.png

Hey everyone! 

We’re very delighted that you are enjoying Röki, and excited by your warm reception! We’re also thankful for your feedback that helps us improve your experience in the Scandinavian wilderness.

With this first update patch, you’ll find a number of bug fixes and improvements, listed below.

Fixes & Improvements:
    ❄️Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck after rescuing the Mother Tree and viewing the following cutscene
    ❄️Fixed an issue inside the Church Interior, in which Tove could get stuck behind the pews, when examining the crypt
    ❄️Fixed an issue where the Star Discs sometimes was not recognised as properly removed
    ❄️Fixed an issue when picking-up the Book wasn’t properly registered, not allowing the player to skip the Flash Hotspots prompt
    ❄️Fixed an issue where the straws sometimes could not stack properly inside the inventory during the Wolf Trial
    ❄️Fixed an issue where starting a new game with an existing save could result in a white screen, forcing a game restart
    ❄️Fixed a bug where picking up the Ancient Fishing Lure could prevent unlocking the "Raven Botherer" badge
    ❄️Fixed an issue where the Sundial puzzle sometimes would result in a freeze
    ❄️Fixed an issue where the player could get blocked after opening the gate to the Sundial Courtyard as Tove, and leaving to the Gatehouse from the Prison as Henrik
    ❄️Optimised circling Ravens for better framerate in lower end PCs

Next up:
    ❄️Improvements to the save system - adding 3 save slots! 
    ❄️Several minor fixes related to the Inventory and Save files
    ❄️Several minor fixes related to the Journal 

Please don’t hesitate to keep sending us comments on the Steam forum, or a message at support@unitedlabelgames.com.

Thank you again for playing!
